'''Prime Councilor''' or '''Prime Counselor''' was a position in the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Naboo Royal Advisory Council]]. [[Kun Lago]] was appointed as [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna's]] Prime Councilor on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].
